verdict.rationale: Cutting and sharing highlight clips is a fair question for a meeting-recording and notetaker product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents sharing whole notes via a link, CSV exports of transcripts, and screen screenshots attached to notes. Nothing shows the product cutting an audio or video soundbite or sharing a single moment of a call.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can cut a soundbite or highlight clip from a call and share that moment instead of the whole recording
